summary: Iteration-3 testing of Lumea e-commerce covering the 4 new features + light regression. Backend: pytest suite grown to 50 tests (added TestLiveRazorpay, TestOrderEmails, TestProductGallery; TestReviews rewritten for verified-buyer rules) -> 49/50 pass (98%). Verified: (1) POST /api/products/{id}/reviews returns 403 'Only verified buyers can review this product' for a non-purchaser AND for a user whose order is payment_status='pending'; returns 200 for a user with a PAID order (seeded directly in db.orders); a second review returns 400 'You have already reviewed this product' and rating/review_count stay at 1/4; rating still clamped to 5. (2) Live Razorpay: POST /api/checkout returns demo_mode=false, razorpay_order.id starting 'order_', amount == total*100, currency INR, razorpay_key_id == rzp_test_TUkfU67KaGDFQI, and razorpay_order_id persisted on the order; a forged signature is rejected with 400 and the order stays pending. (3) Emails: /api/orders/verify -> 200 (no 5xx) and backend logs show 8x 'POST .../api/v1/email/send "HTTP/1.1 202 Accepted"'; PUT /api/admin/orders/{id}/status?status=shipped|delivered returns 200, persists status, and fires the shipping email (202). _assert_safe_email correctly rejects forms and http:// links and accepts the real _email_shell output. Frontend: gallery-main + 3 thumbs render, gallery-thumb-N switches the main image, gallery-next/gallery-prev cycle and wrap correctly, no broken images; verified-review UI happy path + duplicate (400) + non-buyer (403) all show the right toast; Razorpay Test-Mode modal opens from place-order-btn with prefilled email. Regression green: storefront, wishlist toggle+page, cart qty+/remove/subtotal, coupon apply, orders page, admin login->/admin, dashboard stats/charts, inventory list (8), admin order status selects (39 orders). Two carry-over defects are STILL unfixed: /checkout deep-link/refresh bounces to /cart, and the coupon rounding mismatch is now user-visible inside the live Razorpay modal (app says Rs.858, Razorpay charges 858.1).

minor.issue: Rounding mismatch now visible to the payer: subtotal 899 + WELCOME10 -> backend total 858.1 -> Razorpay amount 85810 paise. The app UI and Razorpay 'Price Summary' disagree (Rs.858 vs 858.1). Round the discount/total to whole rupees (or 2dp) identically on both sides.
Still no brute-force lockout/rate limit - 6 consecutive wrong passwords all return 401. test_brute_force_lockout is the single failing test (playbook item 4).

Emergent email proxy rate-limits: the 9th send in a short burst returned 429 Too Many Requests. Handled gracefully (logged, returns None, endpoint still 200), but bulk status updates will silently drop emails. Consider retry/backoff or queueing.

email_order_confirmation/email_shipping_update are awaited inline in the request path (httpx timeout=30), so a slow/failing proxy adds up to 30s latency to /orders/verify and admin status updates. Use FastAPI BackgroundTasks.

Each seed product still has exactly ONE image, so on a fresh database the new gallery (thumbs + arrows) never renders. The multi-image data currently in the DB was added ad-hoc and is not reproducible from code.
allow_credentials=True with CORS_ORIGINS='*' (playbook item 3 wants explicit origins). Harmless today (Bearer tokens, no cookies).
Unused `inp: CouponInput = None` body param still present (dead signature).

Abandoned live-Razorpay orders stay payment_status='pending' forever (39 orders, most pending). No TTL/cleanup, and admin can still move a never-paid order to 'shipped' (which fires a shipping email for an unpaid order).

ui_bugs.issue: HIGH, NOT FIXED (repeat from iteration 2): direct load/refresh of /checkout with items in the cart still redirects to /cart. RCA: StoreProvider's refresh() ignores AuthContext's `loading`; on a hard reload user is null for the first tick, so refresh() takes the `if (!user)` branch, sets cart=[] AND loaded=true immediately, and Checkout's guard fires before /auth/me resolves. Fix: pull `loading: authLoading` from useAuth and `if (authLoading) return;` at the top of refresh() (keep loaded=false until auth settles).
Amount shown to the customer (Rs.858 via inr()) differs from the amount in the Razorpay modal (858.1). Same rounding bug as backend; user-facing on a live payment screen.
Cart quantity +/- buttons had NO data-testid (untestable). FIXED by me: added cart-qty-plus-{id}, cart-qty-minus-{id}, cart-qty-{id}.

issues: Gallery images are recycled photos from OTHER products, not alternate views: 'Ivory Wrap Midi Dress' (Fashion) image 3 is an electronics flat-lay (iPad/phone case/AirPods); 'Minimal Canvas Tote' image 2 is a laptop; 'Ceramic Pour-Over Set' image 2 is a laptop.
'iPad + iPhone Creator Duo' has the SAME url (photo-1572784040789) as image 1 AND image 3 - the gallery shows a duplicate slide with 3 dots.
Prev/next arrows are opacity-0 until hover on the main image, so on touch devices there is no visible way to cycle (thumbnails still work).
For a 'confirmed' order both PENDING and CONFIRMED steps render filled/black - reads as two active states (unchanged from iterations 1-2).

The 'Write a review' form is rendered for everyone; non-buyers only discover they cannot review after submitting and getting an error toast. Consider hiding/disabling the form when the user has no paid order for the product.

action_items: FIX HIGH: StoreContext.refresh() must wait for AuthContext `loading` before setting loaded=true, so /checkout survives refresh/deep-link.
FIX: align coupon rounding between frontend display, backend total and the Razorpay amount (Rs.858 vs 858.1 on the live payment modal).

FIX: add 2-3 real alternate images per product to SEED_PRODUCTS so the gallery is reproducible on a fresh DB, and replace the cross-category / duplicated gallery images currently in the DB (dress showing electronics, tote showing a laptop, iPad Duo repeating image 1 as image 3).
Move email_order_confirmation / email_shipping_update to BackgroundTasks (currently blocking, up to 30s) and handle the proxy's 429 rate limit.
Guard admin status transitions: do not allow shipped/delivered (and shipping emails) for orders with payment_status != 'paid'; consider expiring abandoned pending orders.
Optional/playbook: login brute-force lockout, explicit CORS_ORIGINS, upload mime/size validation, make gallery arrows visible on touch.
critical_code_review_comments: add_review() correctly scopes the paid-order check with {user_id, payment_status:'paid', items.product_id} and the duplicate check on {product_id,user_id} - logic verified for both 403 and 400 paths.
update_order_status() does not verify the order is paid before emailing 'Your order has shipped'; an unpaid/abandoned order can trigger a customer shipping email.

send_email() swallows every exception and returns None, so a permanently broken email provider is invisible to callers and to monitoring - log level is fine but add a metric/alert or at least surface it in the admin response.
SEED_PRODUCTS is the single source of truth for a fresh install and still ships 1 image per product, so the new gallery feature is not reproducible from code.
server.py is 711 lines and mixes email templating (_EmailScan/_assert_safe_email/_email_shell), storage, auth and all routers - split into modules (emails.py, routers/*) before it grows further.

success_rate.frontend: 92% (all new features pass; /checkout deep-link refresh still broken)

rca_of_the_issue: 1) /checkout deep-link: StoreProvider consumes only `user` from AuthContext, not `loading`. On a hard reload AuthContext starts with user=null and asynchronously resolves /auth/me; StoreProvider's refresh() therefore takes the `if (!user)` early-return, sets cart=[] and loaded=true in the same tick, and Checkout's `if (loaded && !placedRef.current && cart.length === 0) navigate('/cart')` fires before the token is validated. Gating refresh() on authLoading fixes it. 2) Rounding: Checkout.jsx computes discount = Math.round(subtotal*pct/100*100)/100 (=89.9) and renders total with inr() which rounds to Rs.858, while the backend stores/charges round(subtotal-discount+shipping,2)=858.1 and sends int(total*100)=85810 paise to Razorpay, so the live modal shows 858.1. 3) Gallery content: the extra image URLs in db.products were copied from other seed products (and one duplicated within the same product) rather than being genuine alternate shots, and SEED_PRODUCTS was never updated, so a fresh DB has single-image products and no gallery.
